facts.label: Igual e o mesmo
facts.sub: Use as + adjetivo + as para igual: as good as. Use the same as + substantivo ou tempo: the same as before. Para menos, not as … as. Não use like nem than.

facts.label: Tão … quanto
facts.sub: Use just as + adjetivo + as para enfatizar a igualdade: just as good as before. É como as … as, só que mais forte. Use no presente ou no passado.

facts.label: O mesmo que
facts.sub: Use the same as + substantivo ou tempo: the same as before, the same sandwich as my brother. Não diga the same like nem the same than.

items.s: Just as good as means equally good.

items.why: We say the same as before.

items.s: As busy as an airport means very busy.
